messages.subject: order x in geom_bar
parts:
Hello,

Im doing like this. My problem is that when I plot my ggplot, the
order of x, is not the same like in my vecX.
How can I keep my order of vecX?


vecY <- round(vec_sum/TotEq *100,0)
vecYlb <- paste(vecY,"%",sep="")
vecX <- names(TablTot[colF:colL])
d <- data.frame(lab=vecX, perc=vecY)

ylabel <- expression(paste("% of each type",sep=""))

ggplot(d, aes(vecX, vecY)) + ylab(ylabel) + opts(title=paste("Type of
responses, N°ID = ",TotEq,sep="")) +geom_bar(stat="identity") +
coord_flip() + geom_text(aes(vecX, vecY+2, label=vecYlb), data=d) +
theme_bw() +
opts(axis.title.x = theme_text(size = 8, vjust=-0.5,face =
"plain", colour = "black"))

> vecX
[1] "lmP" "lmN" "Nt" "expG" "expD" "prbN" "prbP"

>vecY
[1] 43 20 1 6 0 19 10

> d
lab perc
1 lmP 43
2 lmN 20
3 Nt 1
4 expG 6
5 expD 0
6 prbN 19
7 prbP 10

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: order x in geom_bar
parts:
Hi:

vecx <- c("lmP", "lmN", "Nt", "expG", "expD", "prbN", "prbP")
vecy <- c(43, 20, 1, 6, 0, 19, 10)

d <- data.frame(lab = factor(vecx, levels = vecx), perc = vecy)
ggplot(d, aes(lab, perc)) + geom_bar(stat = 'identity')

HTH,
Dennis
